sloka: विद्युत्केशो हेतिपुत्रः स दीप्तार्कसमप्रभः ।व्यवर्धत महातेजास्तोयमध्य इवाम्बुदः ।। ७.४.१८ ॥
transliteration: vidyutkeśo hetiputraḥ sa dīptārkasamaprabhaḥ ।vyavardhata mahātejāstoyamadhya ivāmbudaḥ ।। 7.4.18 ॥

translations.english: Vidyutkeśa, Heti's son, of great splendor and brilliance like the blazing sun, grew like a cloud in the midst of water.
